name: Stereogram
one_liner: Free stereogram (Magic Eye) generator in the browser: shapes, text, a drawing or your own depth map; random dots or a pattern; print-size PNG; no account.

kill_criteria.statement: Not live at stereogram.dravec.org with shapes, text, upload, PNG export and the viewing guide by the deadline
